# Documentation Excellence v4.5.0

Documentation Excellence v4.5.0 adds a connected read-only Document View,
adaptive reading, stable navigation between editing and presentation,
qualitative Documentation Intelligence, Smart Document Profiles, a metadata-only
Document Library, safe Batch Operations and complete workflow polish.

Consultants can record, edit, annotate, restructure, undo/redo, inspect the
planned document, follow advisory guidance, find previous work by meaning,
maintain collections and export professional Word documents in one local flow.
Celebrate Progress acknowledges completed workflow, screenshot, accessibility
and metadata work without numeric quality scoring.

The release preserves the v4.4 semantic document and Word architecture. Review
remains the editable source, the projector is its semantic boundary, Planner
owns presentation intent and the Word adapter only renders validated plans.
Library and batch persistence contain metadata only; explicit batch export loads
one Review at a time through the unchanged Word pipeline.

See [Production Readiness](PRODUCTION_READINESS_4.5.md) and
[Ship Review](SHIP_REVIEW_4.5.md) for verification evidence and product
boundaries.
